note: Codes: data/mexico_2025_safety.do (Bookmark #25, Q2 2024 Harassment) keeps INEGI columns bp4_1_1..bp4_1_9 from conjunto_de_datos_ensu_cb_0624.csv (import delimited case(lower)) and reshapes long with item = column name (core model s3 pattern 1, no positional step); code 9 set missing (lines 220-222 for bp4_1_1..3 outside 2024Q1, 232-237 for bp4_1_4..9). mapping_basis=data_labels: INEGI's Q2 data dictionary labels each BP4_1_n 'Experiencias de victimizacion personal: <situation>' (e.g. BP4_1_1 '...Le dijeron piropos groseros u ofensivos de tipo sexual o sobre su cuerpo...'; BP4_1_5 '...Alguna persona le obligo a tener relaciones sexuales en contra de su voluntad'; BP4_1_9 '...Le obligaron a mirar escenas o actos sexuales o pornograficos...'); 9/9 agree in content with questionnaire 4.1 options 1-9 in the same order. Cross-check (route 9 style): all 9 live item vectors reproduce the raw INEGI Q2 2024 CSV after the .do's recode -- 18/18 item x level counts match (bp4_1_1 1/2 = 2644/21461, bp4_1_2 200/23903, bp4_1_3 372/23731, bp4_1_4 1377/22726, bp4_1_5 73/24034, bp4_1_6 630/23475, bp4_1_7 543/23553, bp4_1_8 1118/22976, bp4_1_9 68/24028); code 9 counts dropped 9/11/11/11/7/9/18/20/18; no blanks, no skip routing into 4.1 (raw 24114 rows, live 216912 rows over 24108 ids). Words: item_text / section_prompt / instructions are the administered Q2 questionnaire wording (text_source=study_materials); all 11 Spanish strings (CP4, 4.1 stem, 9 options) are found verbatim in the Q2 PDF's text layer (p.5) after whitespace normalisation, and a 150-dpi render of p.5 was read to confirm. Where the questionnaire and the data dictionary differ, the questionnaire (what was read) was shipped: items 4 and 8 print 'etcetera' (dictionary 'etc.'); item 6 prints 'ofendida(o) o atemorizada(o)' (dictionary 'ofendida(o), o'). Kept as printed: '(a)'/'(o)' gender fills, 'videos' in item 8 vs accented 'vídeos' in item 9, both as printed. Normalised: line wraps joined with a space. Stripped: question number 4.1, option numbers, dot leaders and I__I boxes, interviewer direction 'MUESTRE LA TARJETA "D" Y REGISTRE EL CODIGO CORRESPONDIENTE A CADA OPCION'. Tarjeta D is not in the questionnaire zip and was not transcribed. Structure: one section (all nine items are options of question 4.1); CP4 (read-aloud section introduction, the only framing text in Section IV) in instructions, the 4.1 question stem in section_prompt, following the batch_675 perception convention. Options: 1 = 'Si', 2 = 'No' printed in the questionnaire and identical in all 9 catalogos; 9 'No sabe / no responde' has no row (set missing by the .do). Step 3b: live items match question 4.1 exactly (9 = 9); dictionary Description ('Self-reported experience with harassment and intimidation in public spaces, Q2 2024') is accurate in scope (the items are specifically sexual harassment/violence); the dictionary Reference names 'ENSU 2023' while data and wording are the 2024 Q2 (file suffix 0624) wave -- same defect as the siblings. English in _translated is this project's own translation (machine_translation); INEGI publishes no English questionnaire.
